card.name: Words right before "adverse reaction"
card.fires_on: The small word or verb just before "adverse reaction" in trial results, such as "reported", "as an", or "most common". It fires where the next word is expected to be "adverse".

modes.label: Reported as an
modes.description: The words "as" or "an" after "reported", leading into "adverse reaction".
modes.example: Tachycardia was reported<< as>> an adverse reaction in 0.6

modes.label: Most commonly reported
modes.description: "reported" or "common" after "most commonly" or "most", just before "adverse reaction".
modes.example: nausea was the most commonly<< reported>> adverse reaction, reported in 40

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "adverse" or similar words like bad and AE next.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a trial summary where the words "adverse reaction" are about to come.
